ifra_limits_value.name: ifra_limits_value
ifra_limits_value.value: ("ifra_limits"."kind" = 'max' and "ifra_limits"."max_value" > 0 and "ifra_limits"."max_value" <= 1) or ("ifra_limits"."kind" = 'prohibited' and "ifra_limits"."max_value" is null)

material_components_what.name: material_components_what
material_components_what.value: ("material_components"."component_id" is not null and "material_components"."component_cas" is null and "material_components"."component_name" is null) or ("material_components"."component_id" is null and length(trim(coalesce("material_components"."component_name", ''))) > 0)

material_components_amount.name: material_components_amount
material_components_amount.value:
case "material_components"."amount_kind"
        when 'exact' then "material_components"."value" is not null and "material_components"."min" is null and "material_components"."max" is null and "material_components"."value" >= 0 and "material_components"."value" <= 1
        when 'max' then "material_components"."value" is not null and "material_components"."min" is null and "material_components"."max" is null and "material_components"."value" > 0 and "material_components"."value" <= 1
        when 'range' then "material_components"."value" is null and "material_components"."min" is not null and "material_components"."max" is not null and "material_components"."min" >= 0 and "material_components"."min" <= "material_components"."max" and "material_components"."max" <= 1
        when 'unknown' then "material_components"."value" is null and "material_components"."min" is null and "material_components"."max" is null
        else false end

material_doses_values.name: material_doses_values
material_doses_values.value: ("material_doses"."min" is null or ("material_doses"."min" >= 0 and "material_doses"."min" <= 1)) and ("material_doses"."typical" is null or ("material_doses"."typical" > 0 and "material_doses"."typical" <= 1)) and ("material_doses"."max" is null or ("material_doses"."max" > 0 and "material_doses"."max" <= 1)) and ("material_doses"."min" is null or "material_doses"."max" is null or "material_doses"."min" <= "material_doses"."max")

materials_kind_owner.name: materials_kind_owner
materials_kind_owner.value: "materials"."kind" not in ('provisional', 'frozen') or "materials"."owner_id" is not null

materials_evolution.name: materials_evolution
materials_evolution.value: coalesce("materials"."evolution_to_15m", 0) between 0 and 3 and coalesce("materials"."evolution_to_2h", 0) between 0 and 3 and coalesce("materials"."evolution_to_8h", 0) between 0 and 3 and coalesce("materials"."evolution_to_24h", 0) between 0 and 3 and coalesce("materials"."evolution_beyond_24h", 0) between 0 and 3

regulations_kind.name: regulations_kind
regulations_kind.value:
case "regulations"."kind"
        when 'max' then "regulations"."max_value" is not null and "regulations"."max_value" >= 0 and "regulations"."max_value" <= 1
        when 'prohibited' then "regulations"."max_value" is null
        when 'requirement' then "regulations"."requirement" is not null and length(trim("regulations"."requirement")) > 0
        else false end
